title: Miromar Lakes vs. WildBlue, Estero FL: Which Is Right for You? 2026
excerpt: WildBlue puts its cost on your tax bill - a CDD of roughly $2,851 to $5,412 a year - and asks nothing to join. Miromar Lakes charges a $739.98 CDD, then puts the real money in the club, including $140,000 to join the golf.
